# Amazon Web Services (AWS)

> > AWS is Amazon's comprehensive cloud computing platform offering global infrastructure, compute services like Amazon EC2 and Amazon EKS, edge computing through AWS Local Zones, and solutions across regions including AWS GovCloud.

Amazon Web Services provides on-demand cloud computing platforms and APIs to individuals, companies, and governments on a metered pay-as-you-go basis. AWS operates a global infrastructure spanning multiple regions and availability zones, with specialized services for low-latency edge computing, data residency compliance, and government workloads.

## Key Topics

- AWS Global Infrastructure
- AWS Local Zones
- Availability Zones
- Amazon EC2
- Amazon EKS
- AWS GovCloud
- Edge Computing

- AWS Academy
